The primary role of ESIs is to treat cervical or lumbosacral radicular pain and, in certain cases, bypass the need for operative intervention.

Published reviews often include a variety of ESI delivery routes, including transforaminal, interlaminar, and caudal, and also encompass a wide range of indications beyond radicular pain, such as axial back pain, failed back syndrome, and spinal stenosis.
